scope: Shared replay job, channel mask, file/network writer, socket, resolver, and buffered protocol infrastructure

applied.name: KWReplayJob_Destroy
applied.evidence: Dispatches reader/writer shutdown by job kind, then destroys the common 0xBB4-byte replay job context.

applied.name: ReplayWriter_SubmitRecordAtFrame
applied.evidence: Enforces monotonic frame order and submits one encoded stream record to the active writer destination.

applied.name: KWReplayReader_ResumeInternal
applied.evidence: Resumes reader stream state, updates accumulated pause time, and optionally notifies a network source.

applied.name: KWReplayChannelMask_FromList
applied.evidence: Converts up to twelve channel identifiers into the protocol bit mask.

applied.name: KWReplayReader_UpdateFileSource
applied.evidence: Advances normal or terminal file-source records and fires the completion callback at EOF.

applied.name: SocketTransport_BeginConnect
applied.evidence: Starts a nonblocking IPv4 socket connection and records connecting state.

applied.name: SocketTransport_ConnectEndpointString
applied.evidence: Parses host:port text and connects the supplied socket transport.

applied.name: KWReplayChannelMask_ToList
applied.evidence: Expands the twelve-bit channel mask into an ordered channel list.

applied.name: KWReplayNetwork_SendPlaybackControl
applied.evidence: Frames and queues replay-network protocol message type 4 carrying the playback control byte.

applied.name: KWReplayWriter_StartNetworkDestination
applied.evidence: Creates the replay network transport and connects it to the configured destination endpoint.

applied.name: KWReplayFile_CloseWithOptionalFooter
applied.evidence: Writes the optional replay footer, closes the file, and clears the owned FILE pointer.

applied.name: BufferedProtocolConnection_Pump
applied.evidence: Pumps both halves of the shared buffered protocol connection.

applied.name: ProtocolRegistry_RegisterName
applied.evidence: Duplicates and registers a protocol name under its numeric identifier.

applied.name: AsyncAddressResolveJob_Destroy
applied.evidence: Closes the resolver handle and frees its result buffer and job object.

applied.name: AsyncAddressResolveJob_TakeResult
applied.evidence: Waits for resolver completion, returns the resolved address, and destroys the resolver job.

applied.name: BufferedProtocolConnection_Configure
applied.evidence: Builds the selected protocol chain, configures the connection, and optionally pumps synchronously until configuration completes.

applied.name: BufferedProtocolConnection_Create
applied.evidence: Normalizes three endpoint/protocol strings and creates the shared buffered connection with callbacks and limits.
